source_notes: This terminal is Ireland's State-led Strategic Gas Emergency Reserve (SGER), owned/operated by Gas Networks Ireland on behalf of the State (govt approval Mar 2025). On 26 Nov 2025 GNI announced the selected site after screening 14 coastal locations: Cahiracon, Co. Clare, on the Shannon Estuary. GEM Location was blank; researcher note (RR 7/25) explicitly asked to fill location once provided. Site = deep-water jetty + onshore facility + new connection to national gas network.
scope_note: Project-level field; single base unit so no other unit-rows to mirror.

source_notes: Selected site Cahiracon is in County Clare, which is in the province of Munster. GEM uses the province (e.g. NextDecade Cork / Pilot Cork = 'Munster') for the Irish State/Province field, so Munster is the convention-consistent value. County = Clare (note in wiki/qa). Field was blank.
